paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма показва точността на шест конфигурации на обучение с подсилване в три показателя: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Категориите са показани на хоризонталната ос и са подредени в азбучен ред. Вертикалната ос показва точността като процент, със стойности от 50 до 62, като скалата е линейна и разделена на интервали от 2. На графиката са изобразени шест групи стълби за всяка категория, като всяка група съдържа по шест стълба: DAPO+Self-reflection (сплош синьо), DAPO (нащриховка в синьо), SRPO (сплош оранжево), GRPO (нащриховка в оранжево), PPO+Self-reflection (сплош зелено) и PPO (нащриховка в зелено). В Mathverse най-високата стойност е около 56%, а най-ниската около 53%. В MMLU най-високата стойност е около 57%, а най-ниската около 54,5%. В Physics най-високата стойност е около 61%, а най-ниската около 57%. Някои от стълбите са визуално подчертани със своята различна окраска според легендата на диаграмата.
model_annotations.Chinese: This bar graph presents a comparison of accuracy across six reinforcement learning configurations and three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists the three benchmarks, while the vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with increments of 2%. The graph features six grouped bars for each benchmark, distinguished by color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In the Mathverse benchmark, the bars range from approximately 53% to 56%, with SRPO at the top (around 56%) and PPO at the bottom (about 53%). For MMLU, the values range from about 54.5% to 57%, with GRPO leading (around 57%) and PPO trailing (at approximately 54.5%). In Physics, the bars span from roughly 57% to 61%, with DAPO+Self-reflection achieving the highest accuracy (around 61%) and PPO the lowest (about 57%). The bars are ordered by method rather than by accuracy, with no additional visual emphasis or sorting applied.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists the categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", scaled linearly from 50 to 62 with tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The chart displays grouped bars for six configurations: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). For Mathverse, the approximate accuracy values are: SRPO at 56%, DAPO+Self-reflection at 55%, and the remaining methods between 53% and 54%. For MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, SRPO at 60.5%, and PPO at approximately 57%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any bars. The grouped bars are visually arranged to compare the performance of each configuration across the three benchmarks.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt einen Vergleich der Genauigkeit von sechs Konfigurationen des verstärkten Lernens über drei Benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse listet die Benchmarks Mathverse, MMLU und Physics auf. Die vertikale Achse ist mit "Accuracy (%)" beschriftet, hat einen Wertebereich von 50 bis 62 und eine regelmäßige Skala mit einem Intervall von 2. Sechs Balken für jede Benchmark-Kategorie sind in Gruppen angeordnet und stellen DAPO+Self-reflection (durchgezogene blaue Balken), DAPO (blaue Balken mit Schraffur), SRPO (durchgezogene orange Balken), GRPO (orange Balken mit Schraffur), PPO+Self-reflection (durchgezogene grüne Balken) und PPO (grüne Balken mit Schraffur) dar. Im Mathverse-Benchmark erreicht SRPO eine Genauigkeit von ungefähr 56%, während DAPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 55% liegt und die übrigen Methoden zwischen 53% und 54% gruppiert sind. Im MMLU-Benchmark führt GRPO mit etwa 57%, knapp vor DAPO+Self-reflection, und PPO liegt bei ungefähr 54,5%. Im Physics-Benchmark erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 61%, SRPO liegt knapp dahinter bei 60,5% und PPO am niedrigsten bei ungefähr 57%. Die Balken sind nach Benchmarks gruppiert und innerhalb jeder Gruppe nach Methodenfarbe sortiert, ohne erkennbare absteigende oder aufsteigende Sortierung. Es gibt keine hervorgehobenen Balken durch Schattierung, Fettdruck, Umrandung oder Anmerkungen.
